sources.name: ibge_pnadc_educacao_ocupados
sources.description: PNAD Continua anual, tabela 7107: distribuicao percentual das pessoas de 14 anos ou mais ocupadas, por nivel de instrucao (SIDRA variavel 4108, categorias 9493/9494/9495/99713/120704)
sources.legal_basis: IBGE open data (Decreto 8.777/2016); SIDRA agregados oficiais
sources.notes: Education marginal of the employed; complements the RAIS 2023 schooling shares built into empirical.py.

sources.name: ibge_pnadc_rendimento_instrucao

sources.legal_basis: IBGE open data (Decreto 8.777/2016); SIDRA agregados oficiais
sources.notes: Wage-by-education means; some cells are suppressed by SIDRA ('...').

sources.name: ibge_pnadc_ocupados_idade

sources.legal_basis: IBGE open data (Decreto 8.777/2016); SIDRA agregados oficiais

sources.name: ibge_cempre_pessoal_secao_cnae
sources.description: CEMPRE (Cadastro Central de Empresas), tabela 3421: pessoal ocupado total e salario medio mensal de unidades locais atuantes, por secao/divisao CNAE 2.0, municipios com 50 mil habitantes ou mais, 2021 (SIDRA variaveis 707 e 1606, classificacao 12762)
sources.legal_basis: IBGE open data (Decreto 8.777/2016); SIDRA agregados oficiais
sources.notes: Sector employment and wage structure; series encerrada em 2021, municipios >= 50 mil habitantes.

sources.name: mte_rais_microdata
sources.description: RAIS microdata (estabelecimento e trabalhador), TXT bulk via FTP (ftp.mtps.gov.br/pdet/microdados/); worker-level records
sources.license: MTE/PDET terms of use (bulk TXT microdata)
sources.legal_basis: Out of scope: worker-level personal data (LGPD art. 5, I) with no documented legal basis for this project (ADR 0012)
sources.notes: Bulk download only; not automated by policy. Aggregates via SIDRA cover the same calibration targets.

sources.name: mte_novo_caged_microdata
sources.description: Novo CAGED microdata (movimentacoes mensais de admissao e desligamento), TXT bulk via FTP; worker-level records
sources.license: MTE/PDET terms of use (bulk TXT microdata)
sources.legal_basis: Out of scope: worker-level personal data (LGPD art. 5, I) with no documented legal basis for this project (ADR 0012)
sources.notes: Bulk download only; monthly flows would need an aggregate publication, which MTE does not expose as an open API.
